label: My Requests
request: i want to change the page title to 'Customer Dashboard (26C)'
markdown:
## Summary
Change the visible page title shown on the smart search page header from "My Requests" to "Customer Dashboard (26C)".

## How it works today
The page uses the `oj-sp-smart-search-page` component, whose `page-title` attribute is set to the literal string "My Requests" in `customer-my-requests-page.html`.

## What changes
Only the displayed heading text needs updating; the `page-title` attribute value changes.

## The change
- `webApps/vbredwoodapp/flows/customer-portal/pages/customer-my-requests-page.html` — change the `page-title` attribute from "My Requests" to "Customer Dashboard (26C)".

## After the change
When a customer opens the My Requests page, the large header at the top of the page will read "Customer Dashboard (26C)" instead of "My Requests". Everything else (subtitle, table, drawer) stays the same.

## Risks
None known — this is a display-only text change on this one page. The URL, flow name, navigation and chains are unaffected.

## How to test
1. Log in and navigate to /vp/shell/customer-portal/customer-my-requests.
2. Confirm the header title at the top of the page now reads "Customer Dashboard (26C)".
3. Confirm the subtitle still reads "Track all your submitted equipment requests" and the requests table loads as before.

## Questions
None.
